create_PerceptualLoss: create a PerceptualLoss instance with a string specifying the loss type such as lpips or lpips+mse
build_combined_loss: build a combined perceptual loss by specifying weighted components like lpips+0.1_mse in the percep_loss string
test_PerceptualLoss_forward: test the PerceptualLoss forward method by passing two image tensors and returning the computed loss value
refactor_PerceptualLoss_to: refactor the PerceptualLoss to method to move activated loss functions to a specified device
summarize_PerceptualLoss: summarize the PerceptualLoss class and its supported loss types including lpips mse yuv ssim msssim and none
